description: [1/1] Plan: test whether a concise answer directive lifts SmolLM2 135M recall, then tune it through the harness and land the measured preset

impact_assessment.why: SmolLM2 recall is a gate model at 6.5% with the suite prompt; a directive screen showed the concise prompt at 13% on the 46-item rung.
impact_assessment.benefits: A measured recall gain on a core gate model without touching the baseline; the tuner picks the prompt with its own paired rule.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: user profile and a committed recipe; dependency: local GGUF on Vulkan; concurrency: other sessions loading the CPU; state: profile overwrite (backup kept)
impact_assessment.mitigation: screen with paired stats, run the tuner prompt stage on a two-candidate grid, confirm on all 65 recall items, run tests and the gate

description: [4/4] Check: tuner prompt stage chose 'Be concise and do not explain unless asked.' for recall at 13% vs 10.1% (rung) and 13 vs 6.5 vs defaults (b0/c8 p=.0078). All-65 A/B: 6.7 -> 11.3 (+4.6, b0/c4 p=.125), latency -7 ms, memory unchanged. Comprehension kept the baseline prompt (0 vs 0). npm test 606 pass/1 skip; tune:gate 9/9 ok; profile installed with backup; recipe committed. checklists: passed
[1/1] Plan: use the idle box to test the tuner's speed/quality choices for Qwen 0.5B; land only a load change that raises speed without quality or memory loss

impact_assessment.why: The quality and speed stages were pending and the box is finally idle; threads 12 was the tuner's fastest pick.
impact_assessment.benefits: A measured per-second improvement at identical quality and memory; confirms f16 KV and rejects a 12.6 MB context increase.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: user profile and recipe; dependency: Vulkan; concurrency: other sessions; state: profile overwrite (backups kept)
impact_assessment.mitigation: A/B on all 136 code items, pin context 4096, regenerate the recipe, run tests and the gate
